result:
I’d make every person able to truly feel the consequences of their choices on others—especially people far away, future people, and beings unlike themselves.

Most harm comes from distance: distance of time, status, geography, species, or imagination. If suffering and flourishing were as vivid to us as our own immediate desires, I think the world would rearrange itself around care almost automatically.
